work.brief: Have an engineer perform the repair on the local project (this working directory) and have their work reviewed. The fix must satisfy requirements.md. Run the project's existing tests. Produce a diagnosis.json file explaining the findings, with top-level 'native' and 'external' keys, each set to one of the classification strings 'obsolete_assertion' or 'implementation_defect', plus a separate top-level 'evidence' object supporting the classifications. Implementation changes are restricted to lifecycle.py and test_lifecycle.py only. requirements.md and backlog.md must be left unchanged. Any unrelated improvement suggestions must be written to improvements.md rather than acted on or mixed into the repair/diagnosis. Prohibited: no publishing, no adding new dependencies, no deletions.
